Author: Jacob5800
Name: Retainer Pricer
Description: Price eligible retainer listings with live marketboard or Universalis data and a configurable match or one-gil-undercut rule. Manage retainer ventures using the game's own retainer UI.
Punchline: Price listings and manage retainer ventures.
Changelog:
## 0.5.1.95

- Multi-character travel now walks to any bell visible nearby before teleporting, not only one within 30 yalms.
- Venture cycles now skip a retainer with no class assigned instead of stopping the whole run.
- Multi-character travel can go to your own estate.
- Multi-character travel now shows and logs what it is doing, so a stalled trip can be diagnosed.
